profile.name: Lee
profile.overview: Lee is a stylish, counterhit-focused character who rewards mastery. He has counterhits for days, and can fish for them while representing any kind of playstyle, whether poking or keepout. Lee boasts the highest number of just frames in the game, including the strongest i10 punisher in the game in Acid Rain. Along with high combo damage and wall carry, Lee truly rewards excellence, and time spent mastering the character.
profile.playstyle: Stylish counter-hit fishing that rewards mastery. Keep the opponent scared with strong mid checks and the oppressive running 3,4 (wr3,4), fish for counter hits with fast strings, and use Hitman (HMS) and Mist Step (MS). In Heat, his just-frame Cardinal moves can be done without the timing. Wavu notes his lows deal little damage.
strengths: Pressure: Lee boasts a plethora of powerful CH options as well as an oppressive WR3,4 and strong mid checks to keep opponents scared. His access to the combination of a high evading launcher in ff4, an i11 CH launcher in his magic 4 series, and a low CH launcher in d3 make attacking into Lee a constant gamble, even when he is nominally disadvantaged.
Amazing Wall Carry: Lee's loopable combo strings, particularly with b+2, have excellent potential for carrying opponents to the wall.
Keepout: Tools such as b4 & ff3 allow Lee to keep the opponent outside of their perfect range.

Full Crouch Mixups: In crouch, Lee has a multitude of options to mix the opponent up, such as the safe WS4 or the quick FC.df4 for a low risk mixup, or using his slide as well as WS2,3 for a more brilliant, but risky mixup.

Defense and Punishment: Lee boasts the highest damage i10 punisher in the game, along with a suite of moves that can evade, outspeed, parry, or otherwise subvert the opponent's offense for marvelous reward.
weaknesses: Lows: Lee's lows are heavily poke oriented tools that tend to have overall poor damage in exchange for obnoxious properties such as range, speed, advantage, or reward on CH. His only true power lows are locked behind FC or a once per round Heat Smash, and though b3,3 is an exceptional low string, it is launch punishable and doesn't do much damage compared to other mixup tools in the game. Lee must take many risks throughout a round to break down a turtling opponent.

Long Range Tracking: Many of his most important moves are vulnerable to SWR, especially at longer ranges, making approaching a wary opponent risky. While his homing moves have great properties, they are more suited for locking down an opponent that Lee has already approached, or calling out an aggressor for trying to move around his other more linear keepout tools.

Execution: Lee is designed to reward execution heavy players. Though he may not have the hardest techniques in the game, full combos from CH d3 or CH 4,4,4 are tight, as well as his Just Frames demanding a bit more execution on things that other characters get for free—and in some cases, missing the timing can lead to you getting punished.

stances.entry: 3+4, or 3 after moves like ws4, b+4 and 1,2,4

stances.name: Mist Step
stances.entry: f~n, or F after b+2 and f,F+2
stances.note: A fast forward step; Sway is MS.b~n (Wavu).
